cases.name: computed_distinct
cases.suffix: RETURN DISTINCT {var}.x + 1 AS v ORDER BY v ASC

cases.name: field_distinct
cases.suffix: RETURN DISTINCT {var}.g AS v ORDER BY v ASC

cases.name: group_id
cases.suffix: RETURN {var}.id AS ident, COUNT(*) AS total ORDER BY ident ASC

cases.name: group_expression
cases.suffix: RETURN {var}.x + 1 AS v, COUNT(*) AS total ORDER BY v ASC

cases.name: count_expression
cases.suffix: RETURN COUNT(1) AS literal, COUNT({var}.k) AS field, COUNT(NULL) AS absent

cases.name: aggregate_order
cases.suffix: RETURN {var}.g AS g, COUNT(*) AS total ORDER BY {var}.g DESC LIMIT 1

cases.name: aggregate_alias_order
cases.suffix: RETURN {var}.g AS g, COUNT(*) AS total ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

cases.name: return_alias_order
cases.suffix: RETURN {var}.x AS v ORDER BY v DESC
